en: A sepia-toned historical photograph showing a large group of uniformed soldiers posing on a bare, sloping hillside. They are holding shovels and other digging tools, suggesting trench or earthwork construction. Most wear long greatcoats and caps typical of early 20th‑century European armies. Some men are standing, others are sitting or lying on the ground in relaxed poses. The background is an open, muddy landscape with no visible buildings or landmarks. The overall style and wear of the image resemble an old military postcard or field photo from the World War I era.
